market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos received only 0.47% of votes in the 2022 presidential election and is not considered a serious contender for 2026. The right-wing field is likely to be led by far more popular figures such as Tarcísio de Freitas, making Santos's chance of finishing second extremely remote, far below the market's 7.3% implied probability.
evidence_points: In the 2022 Brazilian presidential election, Renan Santos finished 9th with just 0.47% of valid votes (≈600,000 votes).
Current polls for 2026 do not include Santos among top-tier candidates; Tarcísio de Freitas is the consensus right-wing frontrunner.
A credible path to second place would require a collapse of all major opposition candidates, which is politically implausible given their institutional support and name recognition.
